page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Running head at top left, page number at top right. Signature at bottom left and catchword at bottom right. No margin notes.

main_text.p: Clementem esse authorem. Paulus quidem Filium magis vocare solet. Frigidiuscule, pace tanti viri. Vanitatem effugij nemo non videt. 1. Filium. paulo vocitari, dicitur vel [?]καλῶς, vel ἐν μέρει. prius, falsum esse docuimus supra, aliquot exemplis. posterius, ut nempe aliquoties filius, licet saepe etiam frater, concludendi vim nullam habet. 11. Negamus, filium unquam Paulo nuncupatum, quoties injecta ipsi Timothei ad alios mentio. Ita perpetuo fratrem, aliquando συνεργὸν dixit. Constabit inductione quadam, ex Actis & Paulinis, nec fugere id Calvinum, aliosque potuit. 111. At filij nomine compellari, quoties ad Timotheum ipsum verba facit Apostolus, ultro largimur. Sic in utriusque inscriptione Epistolae, Τιμοθέῳ τῷ ἀ-γαπητῷ τέκνῳ. Quando jam Timotheum instruit, hortatur, agit cum discipulo, & juniore, & tot sibi nominibus obstricto, familiarius.
V. Denique urgent alij, nihil necesse esse, de priore Timotheo verba intelligi. plures potuisse esse illa aetate cognomines.

page.notes: The catchword reads "1. Ita" at the foot right; I have recorded only "Ita" as the catchword, and the "1." before it is unclear. The Greek word after "vel" is printed as "καλῶς" or similar, read as [?]. The Greek in the inscription line is hyphenated at the line end as printed. The running head is set in italic. No marginal notes or other text on the page.
